Internal procedure for receiving, triaging, and settling household claims.

All household claims must be acknowledged within one business day of first notice of loss. A claims adjuster is assigned within three business days; property damage claims above $25,000 additionally require a field inspection before any settlement offer. Claims may only be discussed with the primary policyholder, a named co-insured, or a household member holding documented authorization. Emergency mitigation costs (water extraction, board-up, temporary housing up to 14 nights) are pre-approved to a limit of $5,000 without adjuster sign-off. Settlement offers require dual approval when the estimate exceeds the adjuster's authority limit of $50,000. Fraud indicators - inconsistent loss dates, recent coverage increases, prior claim clustering - must be escalated to the Special Investigations Unit within 24 hours.
Risk acceptance rules for new household policies and endorsements.

Standard household risks are single-family dwellings built after 1950 with updated electrical, plumbing, and roofing within the last 25 years. Dwellings valued above $1,000,000, homes with commercial use, or properties with prior subsidence require referral to a senior underwriter. Teen drivers aged 15-17 may be added to a household auto endorsement only with a certified driver-education completion and a named-vehicle assignment; a good-student discount of up to 15% applies with a GPA of 3.0 or higher. Car-sharing arrangements with non-resident drivers must be recorded as named endorsements - informal lending of vehicles voids accident forgiveness. Premium quotes are valid for 30 days from issue.
Customer-facing standard terms for SecureHome Premium home insurance (HI-2024 series).

The Premium plan covers dwelling reconstruction up to the scheduled coverage amount, other structures at 10% of dwelling coverage, and personal property at 50% of dwelling coverage, subject to the policy deductible. Full financial details of a policy - coverage amount, deductible, and annual premium - are visible only to the primary policyholder; a spouse or co-resident sees the policy number, coverage type, and term dates unless added as a named insured. Loss of use coverage pays additional living expenses for up to 24 months. Water backup, jewelry above $5,000 per item, and home business equipment require scheduled endorsements. Cancellation by the insured takes effect at 12:01 a.m. on the requested date with pro-rata refund of unearned premium.
